_comment: Known-exploited contracts (runtime bytecode fetched from chain). `expected` lists rule ids any of which must fire at or above `min_severity` for the contract to count as detected. `detectable: false` marks bugs outside what bytecode-level pattern rules can see; they are reported but not counted against recall.

thedao.bug: reentrancy in splitDAO/withdrawRewardFor: ETH sent before balances update

rubixi.bug: constructor renamed to DynamicPyramid(): anyone can become creator

kotet.bug: King of the Ether: send() result ignored, compensation lost

governmental.bug: unbounded storage array iteration / clearing exceeds the block gas limit (DoS)

fomo3d.bug: airdrop() randomness from block attributes, predictable by contracts

bec_token.bug: batchTransfer: cnt * _value overflows, balance check passes

powh.bug: Proof of Weak Hands: underflow in transferFrom allowance handling

spankchain.bug: payment channel: token transfer (malicious ERC20) before state update, reentrancy

lendfme.bug: supply(): imBTC (ERC777) transfer hook re-enters withdraw before balance is written

bancor_network.bug: safeTransferFrom(token, from, to, value) left public: anyone can move approved balances

opyn_options.bug: exercise() checks msg.value once per vault inside a loop: one payment exercises many

pickle_controller.bug: swapExactJarForJar accepts arbitrary jar/target addresses; delegatecall to attacker code

furucombo_proxy.bug: batchExec delegatecalls to caller-chosen handlers; registry allowed an uninitialised Aave proxy

miso_batch_impl.bug: SushiSwap MISO BatchAuction: payable batch() reuses msg.value in each delegatecall

cream_cramp_impl.bug: crAMP borrow(): AMP token hook re-enters before borrow balance is written

visor_vvisr.bug: deposit(): trusts owner() and delegatedTransferERC20() answers of a caller-supplied contract, then mints

umbrella_staking.bug: withdraw(): balance - amount underflows on solc 0.7 without SafeMath

revest.bug: ERC1155 mint callback re-enters depositAdditionalToFNFT before supply bookkeeping

anyswap_router.bug: anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit: transferFrom(from, ...) with caller-chosen token and from

poly_eccm.bug: verifyHeaderAndExecuteTx executes a call whose target and selector come from the (attacker-forged) cross-chain payload

curve_peth_impl.bug: Vyper 0.2.15 codegen gave every @nonreentrant function its own lock slot, so the locks never excluded each other

nomad_replica_impl.bug: process(): acceptableRoot(0) became true after an upgrade initialised confirmAt[0]; any message passes

bob_pool.bug: BOB_POOL (Ethereum Classic): remove_liqudity sends ETC to msg.sender before the stake bookkeeping; the receive hook re-enters and drains the pool
